notes: Survey reports most farmers bearing transport cost to market; most reported costs between FBU 1,000 and 5,000. No route, load quantity, product, or vehicle-level tariff is reported; contextual evidence only.

Reported payment of 60,000 FBu to transport 200 kg of maize from Kayanza to Bujumbura during a fuel shortage. Road distance is externally reported at about 104 km; derived rate = 2,884.6 BIF/tonne-km. The 104 km is not claimed as part of the original transport observation and is retained as external route metadata.
